prompt:
Create unit `tasks` for this task.

Implement `solve`: `a` is a month (1 to 12) and `b` a day (1 to 31). Count the dates from 2018-1-1 through 2018-a-b on which the month number equals the day number: a - 1 if a > b, otherwise a. The contract must state the result exactly, including both cases.

Required signature (in unit `tasks`):
fn solve(a: i64, b: i64) -> (r: i64)
signature: fn solve(a: i64, b: i64) -> (r: i64)

accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(a: i64, b: i64) -> bool { 1 <= a && a <= 12 && 1 <= b && b <= 31 }
spec fn ref_post(a: i64, b: i64, r: i64) -> bool { r == (if a > b { a - 1 } else { a }) && (a > b ==> r == a - 1) && (a <= b ==> r == a) }

verus.signature: fn solve(a: i8, b: i8) -> (result: i8)
verus.pre: bvb_ref_valid_input(a as int, b as int)
verus.post:
result as int == bvb_ref_takahashi_count(a as int, b as int) &&
        (a > b ==> result as int == a as int - 1) &&
        (a <= b ==> result as int == a as int)
